name: io.github.ameerasofficial-ai/web-reader
title: Web Reader Pro
description: Read pages, PDFs, tables, screenshots; research and fact-check with verified quotes. Pay per call.

tools.name: read_url
tools.description: URL in, clean main content out. Strips navigation, ads, cookie banners and boilerplate. Also converts PDF, DOCX, XLSX, ODT and CSV documents. Respects robots.txt. Not charged if the page cannot be read. Price 0.002 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of a page or document

render.description: Force full browser (JavaScript) rendering. Happens automatically when the plain read looks empty.

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: read_urls_batch
tools.description: Same as /read for up to 10 URLs in parallel. Charged only if at least one URL succeeds; each result reports ok or its error. Price 0.008 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

urls.description: Array of up to 10 public URLs

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: page_metadata
tools.description: Fast page metadata for link previews, crawling and source attribution. Price 0.002 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: summarize_url
tools.description: Reads the URL and returns a faithful summary plus 3-7 key points. Optional to: ta, hi, te, kn, ml, bn, mr, gu, ur, ar adds a translated summary. Price 0.005 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

to.description: Optional language code for a translated summary

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: ask_url
tools.description: Answers only from the page content and returns supporting quotes that are checked to appear verbatim in the page. Says found=false instead of guessing. Price 0.01 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: extract_fields
tools.description: Structured data extraction. Send a URL and the fields you want (e.g. name, price, date, email); get a JSON object with one value per field plus the exact page text that supports each value, checked to appear in the page. Missing fields come back as null instead of guessed. Works on JavaScript pages too. Not charged if the page cannot be read. Price 0.005 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of a page or document

fields.description: Up to 25 fields: plain names like ["price", "author"] or objects {"name": "price", "type": "number", "description": "price in USD"}. Types: string, number, boolean, list, date

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: watch_page
tools.description: Creates a page watcher. We re-read the page every 6 hours and record what changed (lines added and removed). Optional keywords: only report changes that mention them. Optional webhook_url: we POST each change to you. Check anytime for free with GET /watch/{watch_id}; cancel with DELETE /watch/{watch_id}. One payment covers the whole watch period. Price 0.02 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

keywords.description: Optional words; only changes mentioning one of them are reported

webhook_url.description: Optional public https URL; each change is POSTed there as JSON

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: research_question
tools.description: Finds sources (Wikipedia search, or the URLs you give), reads each one, pulls out facts with exact supporting quotes that are checked against the source, then writes a short report with numbered citations. Unverified facts are dropped. Not charged if no source can be read or nothing relevant is found. Price 0.05 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

urls.description: Optional: up to 6 source URLs to use instead of searching

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: safe_read_url
tools.description: Reads a page like /read but first scans it for prompt injection aimed at AI agents: hidden text (display:none, zero-size or off-screen elements, HTML comments, attributes), invisible Unicode (tag-character smuggling, zero-width), base64-encoded orders, fake system/chat markers, and visible text that tells AI agents to ignore instructions, leak secrets, run commands or redirect payments. Returns cleaned content plus a risk score (0-100), risk level and every finding with its location. mode=strip (default) removes dangerous lines; mode=flag keeps them and only reports. deep=true adds an AI review. Not charged if the page cannot be read. Price 0.003 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

url.description: Public http(s) URL to read safely

mode.description: strip (default) removes risky text; flag only reports it

deep.description: Also run an AI review for subtle injections (slower)

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: safe_check_text
tools.description: Send text, Markdown, an email body or raw HTML. Returns a risk score, every hidden or suspicious instruction aimed at AI agents (hidden HTML, invisible Unicode, encoded payloads, fake system messages, data-exfiltration or payment-redirect orders) and a cleaned version that is safer to pass to an LLM. deep=true adds an AI review. Price 0.002 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

text.description: The text or HTML to scan (max 200,000 chars)

mode.description: strip (default) removes risky lines from cleaned_text; flag keeps them

deep.description: Also run an AI review for subtle injections

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: translate_url
tools.description: Reads the page and translates the first 4000 characters, keeping numbers, names and links unchanged. Number guard: every number and amount is checked against the source and re-translated if changed; numbers_checked reports the result. Price 0.01 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: crawl_site
tools.description: Starts at the URL and follows links on the same site (only under the same folder by default, or the whole site with scope=site), reading up to 20 pages in parallel. Returns each page's title, word count and clean Markdown. Respects robots.txt. Not charged if the start page cannot be read. Price 0.03 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

scope.description: path (default): only pages under the start folder; site: whole website

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: extract_tables
tools.description: Finds HTML tables (handles header rows, colspan and rowspan) or Markdown tables from PDFs/Excel files, and returns them as JSON objects keyed by column header and/or CSV. Use table_index to get one table. render=true for tables built by JavaScript. Not charged if no table is found. Price 0.003 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: screenshot_url
tools.description: Opens the page in a real Chrome browser, waits for it to load and returns a JPEG or PNG as base64 (MCP clients receive it as an image). Options: full_page, width, height, wait_ms. Useful for visual checks, monitoring, receipts and giving vision models a look at a page. Not charged if the page fails to load. Price 0.01 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

full_page.description: Capture the whole page, not just the first screen

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: verify_claim
tools.description: Give a claim (and optionally up to 5 source URLs; otherwise Wikipedia is searched). Each source is read and judged; every quote is checked word-for-word against the page. Returns verdict (supported, contradicted, disputed, not_enough_evidence), confidence, evidence per source and a corrected claim when it is wrong. Not charged if no source can be read. Price 0.01 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: structure_to_json
tools.description: Send text (or a url) and a JSON Schema (or a simple field list). Returns data that is validated against the schema: numbers cleaned, dates as YYYY-MM-DD, enums matched, required fields checked; if the first try fails it is fixed and re-checked automatically. Each field is marked found_in_source, derived or empty, and missing values are null instead of guesses. Not charged if valid JSON cannot be produced. Price 0.01 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

schema.description: JSON Schema ({type: object, properties: {...}}) or a field list like ["name", {"name": "total", "type": "number"}]

text.description: The messy input (max 200,000 chars). Or use url.

url.description: Instead of text: a page, PDF, Word or Excel URL

strict.description: Default true: error (no charge) if output cannot match the schema

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: read_invoice
tools.description: Reads an invoice, bill or receipt (text, web page, PDF or image URL) and returns vendor, customer, invoice number, dates, currency, line items, discounts, taxes, shipping, total and amount due. Then re-does the maths itself: quantity x price per line, lines vs subtotal, tax rates, subtotal + tax = total, paid vs due, due date after issue date. maths_ok=false means a human should look before paying. Not charged if the document is not an invoice. Price 0.02 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.

tools.name: check_terms
tools.description: Give a site or its terms page (or paste the text). Finds the terms of service and privacy policy, reads them and flags 16 consumer risks: auto-renewal, trial converts to paid, hard to cancel, no refunds, early termination fees, price changes, hidden fees, forced arbitration, class-action waiver, data selling, AI training on your content, broad content licence, terms change without notice and more. Every flag has an exact quote checked against the page. Not legal advice. Not charged if no terms page is found. Price 0.03 USDC per call; first 3 calls per day free.

payment.description: Optional x402 payment (base64 X-PAYMENT header value). Not needed while the free daily sample lasts.
